# Arman Soltani (آرمان سلطانی)

> Electrical engineer, web developer, IT specialist and data analyst based in Shiraz, Iran. Founder or CTO of six companies.

Arman Soltani was born 26 January 1996 in Iran and holds a BCA in Electrical Engineering from Shiraz University. He works professionally as a web developer, IT specialist and data analyst, and leads six companies across furniture manufacturing, cosmetics, smart hardware and construction.

## Roles
- Electrical Engineer
- Web Developer
- IT Specialist
- Data Analyst
- Founder / CEO / CTO
